Map of the regions, animated by year

Source: R/fct_plots.R
plot_regions.Rd

The regions of the NUTS 2024 classification at level 2 colored by the value of the indicator, as in golemworldbank: from red for the lowest through white to dark blue for the highest, on one scale for all the years.

Usage

plot_regions(data, indicator)

Arguments

data

Data frame from get_regional().

indicator

The id of a regional indicator in indicators().

Value

A plotly object.

Examples

data <- data.frame(
  geo = c("EL30", "EL52"), region = c("Attiki", "Kentriki Makedonia"),
  country = "Greece", year = 2024, value = c(105, 58)
)
plot_regions(data, "r_gdp_pps")
